description:
When you attack with your orb, you may bounce it off a flat surface as part of its trajectory. The total distance it travels for the attack must still be within its range.

If the target of the attack is a creature that you can see, you may roll Dexterity vs Dexterity for the attack roll.

Describe your bank shot.
name: Bank Shot

improvements.name: Play!
improvements.description: You may attempt to bounce the orb off of any creature or object that is at least as large as your orb. If you do, your Dexterity roll is ill-favored.
